items.body: Freshness prerequisite checks move inside xtask, but the plan does not explain how they run before xtask can be built. On a cold checkout missing mise, pinned Rust, or Cargo, bootstrap fails before reaching the required local warning/skip policy. Disabling automatic installation inside xtask is also too late for bootstrap. The existing `test_missing_prerequisites_skip_only_with_ci_unset` explicitly covers these missing tools; running its replacement against an already-built binary would miss this regression.
items.suggestion: Specify admission before native-tool bootstrap, including where automatic installation is disabled. Preserve local skip versus empty-CI failure, distinguish missing prerequisites from probe/build failures, and test the actual freshness entrypoint with no cached xtask and each bootstrap prerequisite absent.
